# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/netlify
# args: 
Open settings for the project linked to the current folder

USAGE
  $ netlify open [options]

OPTIONS
  --admin            Open Netlify project
  --filter <app>     For monorepos, specify the name of the application to run
                     the command in
  -h, --help         display help for command
  --site             Open project
  --debug            Print debugging information
  --auth <token>     Netlify auth token - can be used to run this command
                     without logging in

EXAMPLES
  $ netlify open --site
  $ netlify open --admin
  $ netlify open:admin
  $ netlify open:site

COMMANDS
  $ open:admin       Opens current project admin UI in Netlify
  $ open:site        Opens current project url in browser
